No selected state for category pills / budget chips / occasion chips is drawn in these frames. Figma component note for category pill: 'Selected ... uses a light violet fill'. Suggest selected = background rgba(208,36,255,0.08); border-color #d024ff.

greeting.html:
Hi, I’m Pickoo 👋 Your AI team for creating and getting things done.

  • Video creation — Turn ideas or product images into product videos, brand ads, and short dramas. Remix trending videos in your style, or bring photos to life with magic effects.
  • Images & documents — Create posters, product shots, slides, and illustrated books.
  • Personal assistant — Organize emails, summarize meetings, and track next steps.

Log in and bring your first idea to life!

_notes: Filter counts match data: All 8, Target reached 1 (Native Union), Watching 5, Paused 2 (Rattan, Fellow Aiden).

Three card states: watching (toggle on, blue 'Alert at ...' line), target reached (toggle on, violet sparkle + '#d024ff' line 'Target reached. ...'), paused (toggle off, product block opacity .5, gray 'Paused. Your target is saved at $X.' and 'Notifications paused · Target saved' instead of Notify-via chips).
Every card uses the same placeholder variant line 'White / Teal · Size 40' (even for headphones/charger/coffee maker).
Expanded grid cards are 632 wide (gap 16) in 1519:74765; the chooser/success/delete frames use a 'collapsed' grid at 628 wide (gap 24) with only 6 visible cards - same data.
Add Auto-Task chooser modal title reads 'Edit Description' (layer 'Edit Agent') - wrong copy; probably should be 'Add Auto-Task'. Uses Inter Medium 20px unlike the SF Pro elsewhere.
'Success' state is just a top-center toast 'Added successfully' (green check) - layer text says 'A maximum of 10 photos may be uploaded.' but renders 'Added successfully'.

'Delete' state is a dropdown from the '...' button with one item 'Delete task' (red, hover bg). Component note: menu should also show Pause/Resume and Adjust target, and Delete requires a confirmation - none of those are drawn.
Empty state body copy is 'No auto-task yet' repeated 4x (placeholder) and filters + Add button are hidden; CTA 'Set Auto-task'. Header 'Chat' has no unread dot in this frame.
The 'Adjust with Pickoo' button layer is named 'Adjust with Okiee' (old brand).

_notes: Favorites page is wider than other pages: 80px side padding on a 1760px content row, 5 columns (332.8px cards, gap 24px), title 'Favorites Products' 40px. Cards reuse the chat grid card; all 15 are placeholder 'A.P.C. Lou Canvas Tote…' $87.00/$115.00 except card 5 which shows the Polaroid image (no favorite-heart/remove control is drawn on cards).
On the filled Favorites frame the nav highlights 'Explore' (bold), not 'Favorites' - copy/paste slip; the empty Favorites frame correctly bolds 'Favorites'.

Logged-in header = logged-out header with the 'Log in' pill replaced by a 40px round avatar (gap 12px after the 'Add Pickoo to Chrome' pill). 717:30904 shows the fallback avatar: #f6f6f6 circle with initial 'C' in #d024ff 510 15.6px; 717:30953 shows the photo avatar (assets/img/avatar.png). Nothing else differs.

User menu (1519:68720) shows two states: default and row-hover (hover bg rgba(0,0,0,0.02) radius 8 on 'Web Permissions'; frame is named 'Language hover'). Language row uses a dark right chevron (submenu), others a light gray chevron. Logout is red #ee2c4a. Name is 'Xiaoqing Ma' with an edit pencil and a camera badge on the avatar.

Feedback modal 'From:' shows a real-looking employee email (xiaoqing.ma@shopee.com) - replaced with a placeholder in this JSON; Submit button is disabled (opacity .22) until text entered. Layer name 'Boss Email Alert'; mixes Inter/Roboto/SF Pro.

Login modal terms copy says "Vicoo's Terms of Service" (wrong brand) and footer 'Powered by Migoo'. Only Google sign-in is visible (Apple button hidden). Behind it the homepage shows a floating 'Ask Pickoo' composer (bottom center, 800px) - not in the other homepage frames.
Chat tab has a small unread dot in most frames (#d024ff, ~6px at top-right of 'Chat'); the empty Favorites header has the dot slot but it is empty.
